steps: Turn off power at the breaker and test with a voltage tester.
Confirm the dimmer is rated for your bulb type (LED-compatible dimmers exist).
Remove the old switch and note wire positions.
Wire the dimmer to match (some have a ground pigtail to connect).
Mount, cover, restore power, and test the dimming range.
